# Modern Treasury — Style Reference

> Ledger paper, ink-ruled boxes, one forest-green rail tag. Book-weight grotesk headlines on warm off-white, 1px ink rings for every action, mono uppercase labels, and forest green spent only where money actually moves.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Modern Treasury speaks a ledger-paper infrastructure language. The body canvas is Linen Canvas #f8f7f5, content is laid on Paper #ffffff, and product cards are recessed into Parchment Card #f8f5f4 rather than lifted off it. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue, forest green, spent in four values (#29735c, #215b4b, #bae0cf, #0c221d). It is permitted only on the logo, the payment-rail tags, the active stepper, code highlights and the footer, while every call to action stays Ink #151515. Typography splits by optical size: MT Neue Display at 450 for the 47px and 71px headlines, MT Neue Text at 400 for 21px and 32px, MT Sans at 330 and 360 for body, and MT Mono for rail names and JSON. Headline steps climb at a 1.5 ratio, far steeper than the Perfect Fourth, so size carries hierarchy and the heaviest stroke on the page (600) is saved for button labels. Corners hold at 2px for actions and 8px for cards. Elevation is a 1px inset ink ring, not a shadow. The page reads as a bank's internal ledger rather than a fintech marketing site.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linen Canvas | `#f8f7f5` | `--color-linen-canvas` | Body background, announcement strip and code-panel header bar. A warm off-white that keeps the ledger from glaring like printer stock. |
| Paper | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper` | 19 background uses across the nav bar, content sections, form inputs and product mockup tiles. It is the brightest plane, so anything white reads as foreground UI. |
| Parchment Card | `#f8f5f4` | `--color-parchment-card` | Feature cards in the 2×2 product grid. A tonal recess one notch warmer than Paper that replaces borders and shadows entirely. |
| Quartz Quote | `#f9f6f8` | `--color-quartz-quote` | Full-width testimonial cards. A faintly rose sibling of Parchment reserved for customer voices. Do not use it for product cards. |
| Forest Floor | `#0c221d` | `--color-forest-floor` | Footer band and newsletter block only. A green-black inverted surface that closes the page on the accent hue instead of on neutral black. |
| Ink | `#151515` | `--color-ink` | 38 text uses and 8 fills: headlines, button labels, the solid CTA fill and the inset button ring. Near-black keeps type soft on warm paper. |
| Graphite Body | `#151515cc` | `--color-graphite-body` | 24 uses for the hero subhead, feature-card descriptions and section intros. 80% ink subordinates body copy without adding a second gray. |
| Ash Caption | `#15151580` | `--color-ash-caption` | Stat labels, stepper descriptions and mono step numerals. 50% ink is the metadata voice and is quiet enough to sit beside 47px numbers. |
| Fog Footer | `#ffffff99` | `--color-fog-footer` | 30 uses for footer link columns, newsletter copy and legal lines. 60% white is the secondary-text tier on Forest Floor. |
| Steel Hairline | `#15151533` | `--color-steel-hairline` | Rules above and below stats, the logo strip, the code-panel frame and stepper connectors. 20% ink lines draw the ledger grid without darkening it. |
| Forest Signal | `#29735c` | `--color-forest-signal` | Logo mark, ACH rail tag, active stepper ring and BUSINESS toggle. It is the single saturated hue and marks money in motion. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Moss Label | `#215b4b` | `--color-moss-label` | 14 uses: mono text inside mint rail tags and inline accent text. A deeper green that clears contrast on mint where Forest Signal would wash out. |
| Mint Tag | `#bae0cf` | `--color-mint-tag` | Rail-tag fills and JSON value highlights in the code panel. It is the tint form of the accent, reserved for data. Do not use it as a button fill. |

## Tokens — Typography

### MT Neue (Display + Text cuts) — optical-size grotesk that sets every heading from 21px to 71px · `--font-mt-neue`

- **Substitute:** Inter Display at 450, Geist at 450, Hanken Grotesk at 450. The Display cut draws true to its nominal 450, a touch heavier than a regular, so keep 450 on variable substitutes and do not drop to 400. For the 21px and 32px Text cut, use Inter (text optical size) at 400.
- **Weights:** 400, 450
- **Sizes:** 21, 32, 47, 71
- **Line height:** 1.1 (71px), 1.25 (47px and 32px), 1.3 (21px)
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 21px, 0px at 32px, 0px at 47px, 0px at 71px
- **OpenType features:** `cv10`, `ss07`, `ss08`
- **Role:** The two optical cuts are the signature: Display at 450 for the 47px and 71px steps, Text at 400 for the 32px card titles and 21px quotes. Headlines are massive and quiet rather than heavy. The steps climb 21 → 32 → 47 → 71 at a ratio of 1.5. That is a Perfect Fifth, deliberately steeper than the 1.25 or 1.333 conventions most SaaS sites use, so size alone ranks the page. Zero tracking at 71px is anti-convention for display type and keeps the setting bookish rather than poster-like.

### MT Sans — the UI and body workhorse, 117 elements carrying the stylistic sets · `--font-mt-sans`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 350, Geist at 350, Public Sans at 350. MT Sans 330 renders slightly heavier than its number, closer to a 350 Inter, so match the visual weight. Map 600 labels to Inter 600.
- **Weights:** 330, 360, 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 14, 16, 18
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 14px, 0px at 16px, 0px at 18px
- **OpenType features:** `cv10`, `ss07`, `ss08`
- **Role:** Body copy sits below regular at 330 and 360. This is intentional: reading text is lighter than headlines, which are lighter than buttons, an inverted ladder that makes 600 action labels the darkest marks on the page. The 14 → 16 → 18 sizes step by only 1.13, a compact UI ramp that leaves all dramatic scaling to MT Neue. A single 1.5 line height throughout gives the rhythm of a ruled ledger.

### MT Mono — the machine voice for rails, endpoints and JSON · `--font-mt-mono`

- **Substitute:** JetBrains Mono at 400, IBM Plex Mono at 400, Geist Mono at 400. The original draws near nominal weight. Use 500 only on tracked 11px labels.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 11, 13 (10px and 10.5px instances snapped to 11px; one 12.5px instance snapped to 13px)
- **Line height:** 1.5 at 11px, 1.69 at 13px
- **Letter spacing:** 0.66px at 11px, 0px at 13px
- **OpenType features:** `cv10`, `ss07`, `ss08`
- **Role:** Mono marks anything a computer would read: rail names (ACH, RTP, FEDNOW), HTTP methods, step numerals and request bodies. The 13px code setting runs at 1.69 line height, airier than editor convention, so JSON reads as an exhibit rather than a terminal. The 0.66px (0.06em) tracking on 11px uppercase is the only positive tracking in the system, which makes it punctuation rather than decoration.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | MT Mono | 500 | 11px | 1.5 | 0.66px | `--text-small` |
| caption | MT Mono | 400 | 13px | 1.69 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | MT Sans | 330 | 14px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | MT Sans | 360 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | MT Sans | 360 | 18px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | MT Neue Text | 400 | 21px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | MT Neue Text | 400 | 32px | 1.25 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | MT Neue Display | 450 | 47px | 1.25 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| display | MT Neue Display | 450 | 71px | 1.1 | 0px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Fill the primary CTA with Ink #151515 and a #ffffff label at MT Sans 600. This is non-negotiable: the action stays ink and green stays with the money.
- Hold button and tag corners at 2px, menu tiles at 4px and cards at 8px. Three small radii keep the page rectilinear like a printed form.
- Draw every button outline as `inset 0 0 0 1px #151515` rather than a CSS border. Solid and outline variants then share an identical box and align to the pixel.
- Set headlines in MT Neue Display at 450 with 0px tracking and step them by 1.5 (32px, 47px, 71px). Size ranks the page, not weight.
- Spend green only on money artefacts: #bae0cf tags with #215b4b text, and #29735c for the single active rail, step or toggle. One saturated object per view keeps the signal readable.
- Set rail names, HTTP methods and step numerals in MT Mono 11px at 500, uppercase, with 0.66px tracking. Mono marks what a machine reads.
- Recess cards into Parchment Card #f8f5f4 on Paper #ffffff with no border and no shadow. A 1-step tonal shift does the work of elevation.

### Don't

- Don't paint the primary button #29735c or #bae0cf. Green belongs to money in motion, not to the sales ask, and a green CTA would merge the rails with the conversion path.
- Don't bold headlines to 600. The 450 Display weight is the restraint, and 600 belongs to button labels, so heavy headlines would outshout every action.
- Don't round buttons to 9999px pills. That radius is reserved for stepper rings and status dots, and a pill CTA would read as a state indicator.
- Don't add the md or lg shadow to Parchment feature cards. Shadows belong only to #ffffff mockup tiles depicting the product, and shadowed chrome breaks the flat ledger.
- Don't set text in pure black or a mid-gray hex. Use #151515 and its 80%, 50% and 20% alpha steps so every neutral stays one ink at varying density.
- Don't track MT Sans or MT Neue. Positive letter-spacing exists only at 0.66px on 11px mono labels, and tracked headlines would turn the broadsheet into a poster.
- Never introduce a second hue (blue links, red errors, amber badges) in marketing mockups. Status uses a #29735c 9999px dot, and a second color doubles the chromatic budget.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f8f7f5 (Linen Canvas)
- section and tile surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- card surface: #f8f5f4 (Parchment Card)
- text: #151515 (Ink)
- border: #15151533 (Steel Hairline)
- accent: #29735c (Forest Signal)
- primary action: #151515 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and diagrams render one highlighted series in solid #29735c, a secondary series in #bae0cf, and everything else in #15151533 lines or #f8f5f4 fills, so green marks the single figure that matters and never outweighs the ink headline above it.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an `<a>` with background #151515, text #ffffff, MT Sans (fallback Inter) 16px weight 600, line-height 1.5, padding 8px 14px for a 40px height, border-radius 2px, no CSS border, box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px #151515`, label "Talk to us →". Pair it with a secondary button 8px to its right: transparent background, text #151515, the same padding, radius 2px and inset ring. Hover on either: background stays put, and the arrow shifts 4px right. No green anywhere.

2. Build a hero section: a full-width #ffffff band with 120px top padding. Center an h1 "Build Products That Move Money" in MT Neue Display (fallback Inter Display) 71px weight 450, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing 0px, color #151515, max-width 896px. Below it at a 24px gap, place a subhead in MT Sans 18px weight 360, line-height 1.5, color #151515cc, max-width 672px. Then add the two-button pair from prompt 1 at a 32px gap. Beneath, add a diagram: a square #151515 logo tile with 1px #15151533 connectors to uppercase MT Mono 13px tags (#bae0cf fill, #215b4b text, 2px radius, 4px 12px padding). One "ACH" tag gets #29735c fill with #ffffff text.

3. Build a feature card: a 576px column, background #f8f5f4, border-radius 8px, padding 48px, no border, no shadow. Title in MT Neue Text 32px weight 400, line-height 1.25, color #151515. At a 12px gap, a description in MT Sans 16px weight 360, line-height 1.5, color #151515cc. At a 16px gap, a text link in MT Sans 14px weight 600, color #151515, ending in "→". At a 48px gap, a mockup tile: background #ffffff, radius 6px, padding 16px, box-shadow `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)`, with column labels in MT Mono 11px weight 500 uppercase at 0.66px tracking.

4. Build a navigation bar: background #ffffff, height 64px, static position, inner container 1200px. On the left, a 17px-tall wordmark in #29735c. In the center, menu items in MT Sans 14px weight 500, color #151515, padding 4px 8px, radius 4px, hover background #f8f7f5. On the right with an 8px gap: "Log in" and "Start building" as outline buttons (transparent, #151515 text, `inset 0 0 0 1px #151515`, radius 2px, padding 6px 12px, 14px weight 600) and "Talk to us" as a solid #151515 button with #ffffff text at the same size. Below the nav, a #f8f7f5 announcement strip with 14px 32px padding and centered 14px weight 500 text.

5. Build a stat row: three equal columns inside 1200px with a 48px gap, each with a 1px #15151533 top and bottom border and 32px vertical padding, text centered. Set the number in MT Neue Display 47px weight 450, line-height 1.25, color #151515. Set the label in MT Sans 16px weight 360, line-height 1.5, color #15151580. No fills, no radius, no icons.

**Role:** Developer path, "Start building", "Log in"

**Role:** Static top bar with three-tier actions

Centered menu items (Products, Solutions, Resources, Docs with chevrons, Customers, Pricing) use MT Sans 14px at 500 in Ink #151515 with 4px 8px padding and a 4px radius hover tile. On the right sit Log in (outline), Start building (outline) and Talk to us (solid), separated by an 8px gap. The 4px menu radius is the only place 4px appears, which keeps menu tiles distinct from 2px actions.

### Announcement Banner

**Role:** Single-line event promo below nav

A ledger header line. Background Linen Canvas #f8f7f5, full 1440px wide, 14px 32px padding, and centered MT Sans 14px at 500 in #151515, closed by an underlined "Register now →" link at 600. It has no border, radius or icon. The tonal shift from Paper to Linen is its only separator, which shows how the system replaces lines with surface steps.

### Feature Card — Parchment (2×2 Product Grid)

**Role:** Product-line entry with live mockup

A recessed panel. Background Parchment Card #f8f5f4, 8px radius, no border, no shadow, and 48px internal padding on a 576px column. The title is MT Neue Text 32px at 400 in #151515. The description is MT Sans 16px at 360 in Graphite Body #151515cc. The 14px 600 "Explore … →" text link sits 16px below, and a white mockup tile anchors the lower half. The card sinks into the page instead of floating above it, which is the system's elevation-by-recession.

### Product Mockup Tile

**Role:** Miniature UI inside feature cards

The system outlier, a floating fragment. Background #ffffff, 6px radius, the lg shadow `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)`, 16px padding, MT Sans 14px rows, MT Mono 11px uppercase column labels with 0.66px tracking, and amounts in MT Sans 16px at 600. It is the only place real shadows appear. The exception is allowed because the tile depicts the product, not the site: depth signals "this is software" while the site chrome stays flat.

### Rail Tag — Mono (Mint, with Forest Active)

**Role:** Payment-rail labels in hero diagram

A machine label. Background Mint Tag #bae0cf, text Moss Label #215b4b, MT Mono 13px at 400 in uppercase, 2px radius, and an estimated 4px 12px padding. Tags connect to a central ink logo tile with 1px Steel Hairline #15151533 connectors. The ACH tag is the deliberate outlier: Forest Signal #29735c fill with #ffffff text, plus a solid green connector. It is the one fully saturated object above the fold and shows the rail currently carrying money.

### Stat Block — Hairline Ruled

**Role:** Proof metrics in three columns

A ledger row. Three columns inside the 1200px container, each bounded top and bottom by a 1px #15151533 rule, with no fill and no radius. The figure ("$700 Billion", "99.99%", "One API") is MT Neue Display 47px at 450 in #151515 over a centered MT Sans 16px 360 label in Ash Caption #15151580, with 32px vertical padding and a 48px column gap. The ruling instead of boxing turns marketing numbers into a printed statement.

### Process Stepper

**Role:** Four-step lifecycle, onboard to operate

A timeline rail. A 1px #15151533 horizontal connector joins four 9999px ring markers. The active marker is a 5px #29735c border around a #29735c dot, and inactive markers are 1px #15151533 rings. Below each marker sit an MT Mono 11px numeral in #15151580, a title in MT Sans 16px at 600, and a description in 14px at 330 in #15151580. The pill radius appears only here and on status dots, which keeps round shapes a state indicator rather than a styling choice.

### Code Panel — Request / Response

**Role:** Live API exhibit with toggle

A framed exhibit. A 1px #15151533 frame with a 2px radius. A Linen Canvas #f8f7f5 header strip carries "POST /api/legal_entities" in MT Mono 13px, with the method in #29735c. The request pane is #ffffff and the response pane is a pale mint (#f0f9f5, mockup-internal, not a system token). JSON is set in MT Mono 13px with a 1.69 line height, and matching values are highlighted in #bae0cf. The BUSINESS / INDIVIDUAL toggle uses MT Mono 11px at 500: #29735c fill with white text when active, a 1px #15151533 ring when inactive.

### Testimonial Card — Quartz

**Role:** Customer quote, full-width band

A tinted quote slab. Background Quartz Quote #f9f6f8, 8px radius, no border or shadow, spanning the full 1200px container. The quote is set in MT Neue Text 21px at 400 in #151515, and attribution in MT Sans 14px at 330 in Graphite Body #151515cc. The faint rose cast separates customer speech from Parchment product cards without introducing a second hue.

### Text Link with Arrow

**Role:** Inline navigation to product pages

Bare ink. MT Sans 14px at 600 in #151515, no padding, no radius, no underline by default (the banner variant is underlined), with a trailing → glyph after a 4px space. It always closes a card or banner, never starts one, and the arrow carries the affordance so the link does not need color.

### Footer — Forest Floor with Newsletter

**Role:** Closing band, newsletter and sitemap

An inverted ledger. Background Forest Floor #0c221d, white headings, link columns in MT Sans 14px at 330 in Fog Footer #ffffff99, and dividers drawn as a white hairline at 20% alpha (#ffffff33, footer-only, not a system token). The newsletter input is #ffffff with a 0px radius, 8px 12px padding, a 40px height, and MT Sans 16px at 500 in #151515. Ending on green-black instead of ink is the one place the accent becomes a surface.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Fill the primary CTA with Ink #151515 and a #ffffff label at MT Sans 600. This is non-negotiable: the action stays ink and green stays with the money.
- Hold button and tag corners at 2px, menu tiles at 4px and cards at 8px. Three small radii keep the page rectilinear like a printed form.
- Draw every button outline as `inset 0 0 0 1px #151515` rather than a CSS border. Solid and outline variants then share an identical box and align to the pixel.
- Set headlines in MT Neue Display at 450 with 0px tracking and step them by 1.5 (32px, 47px, 71px). Size ranks the page, not weight.
- Spend green only on money artefacts: #bae0cf tags with #215b4b text, and #29735c for the single active rail, step or toggle. One saturated object per view keeps the signal readable.
- Set rail names, HTTP methods and step numerals in MT Mono 11px at 500, uppercase, with 0.66px tracking. Mono marks what a machine reads.
- Recess cards into Parchment Card #f8f5f4 on Paper #ffffff with no border and no shadow. A 1-step tonal shift does the work of elevation.

### Don't

- Don't paint the primary button #29735c or #bae0cf. Green belongs to money in motion, not to the sales ask, and a green CTA would merge the rails with the conversion path.
- Don't bold headlines to 600. The 450 Display weight is the restraint, and 600 belongs to button labels, so heavy headlines would outshout every action.
- Don't round buttons to 9999px pills. That radius is reserved for stepper rings and status dots, and a pill CTA would read as a state indicator.
- Don't add the md or lg shadow to Parchment feature cards. Shadows belong only to #ffffff mockup tiles depicting the product, and shadowed chrome breaks the flat ledger.
- Don't set text in pure black or a mid-gray hex. Use #151515 and its 80%, 50% and 20% alpha steps so every neutral stays one ink at varying density.
- Don't track MT Sans or MT Neue. Positive letter-spacing exists only at 0.66px on 11px mono labels, and tracked headlines would turn the broadsheet into a poster.
- Never introduce a second hue (blue links, red errors, amber badges) in marketing mockups. Status uses a #29735c 9999px dot, and a second color doubles the chromatic budget.

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |

| 0 | Linen Canvas | `#f8f7f5` | Body background, announcement strip, code-panel header bar |
| 1 | Paper | `#ffffff` | Content sections, nav bar, inputs, request pane, mockup tiles |
| 2 | Parchment Card | `#f8f5f4` | Feature cards recessed into Paper; Quartz Quote #f9f6f8 is its testimonial sibling |
| 3 | Ink | `#151515` | Solid CTA fill and the central logo tile in the rail diagram |
| 4 | Forest Floor | `#0c221d` | Footer band, the only accent-colored surface |

## Elevation

- **Every button, solid and outline (9 elements):** `inset 0 0 0 1px #151515`
- **Small floating mockup widgets inside cards:** `0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`
- **Large product mockup tiles ("Your platform", "Payment order"):** `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)`
- **Nav, cards, stats, code panel, footer:** `none`. Hierarchy comes from the Linen → Paper → Parchment tonal steps and 1px #15151533 hairlines.

## Imagery

There is no photography. Imagery is product UI rebuilt as live HTML mockups: white tiles with 6px corners and the 4% lg shadow, set inside Parchment cards and populated with plausible ledger data (names, routing numbers, $12,400.00 balances) in MT Sans and MT Mono. The hero is a schematic: a square ink logo tile wired by 1px hairlines to mono rail tags in mint, with ACH lit in forest. A faint square grid of hairlines fades in at the upper right of the hero, a decorative texture and not a system token. Customer logos run as a monochrome wordmark marquee between two #15151533 rules. Icons are small square glyph tiles with a mint fill. There are no gradients, glows or orbs. The narrative is money flowing through visible pipes.

## Layout

Content is held to a 1200px container, and the announcement banner and hero backdrop stretch to 1440px. Sections stack with 60px padding top and bottom, producing a 120px rhythm between bands. The hero is a centered single column: a 71px headline at a 896px measure, an 18px subhead at 672px, two 40px buttons with an 8px gap, then the rail diagram. Sections alternate between centered heading blocks and grids: a 2-column feature grid with a 48px gap, 3 ruled stat columns, a 4-step stepper, a 2-pane code panel, and a full-width testimonial. The logo row is a single 8-logo marquee, and the page has no pricing grid. The 64px nav is white and static, with the logo on the left, menu in the center and three buttons on the right. The footer is a dark Forest Floor band with newsletter and link columns. At 375px, drop the display to 47px and the section gap to 64px. Density: comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f8f7f5 (Linen Canvas)
- section and tile surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- card surface: #f8f5f4 (Parchment Card)
- text: #151515 (Ink)
- border: #15151533 (Steel Hairline)
- accent: #29735c (Forest Signal)
- primary action: #151515 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and diagrams render one highlighted series in solid #29735c, a secondary series in #bae0cf, and everything else in #15151533 lines or #f8f5f4 fills, so green marks the single figure that matters and never outweighs the ink headline above it.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an `<a>` with background #151515, text #ffffff, MT Sans (fallback Inter) 16px weight 600, line-height 1.5, padding 8px 14px for a 40px height, border-radius 2px, no CSS border, box-shadow `inset 0 0 0 1px #151515`, label "Talk to us →". Pair it with a secondary button 8px to its right: transparent background, text #151515, the same padding, radius 2px and inset ring. Hover on either: background stays put, and the arrow shifts 4px right. No green anywhere.

2. Build a hero section: a full-width #ffffff band with 120px top padding. Center an h1 "Build Products That Move Money" in MT Neue Display (fallback Inter Display) 71px weight 450, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing 0px, color #151515, max-width 896px. Below it at a 24px gap, place a subhead in MT Sans 18px weight 360, line-height 1.5, color #151515cc, max-width 672px. Then add the two-button pair from prompt 1 at a 32px gap. Beneath, add a diagram: a square #151515 logo tile with 1px #15151533 connectors to uppercase MT Mono 13px tags (#bae0cf fill, #215b4b text, 2px radius, 4px 12px padding). One "ACH" tag gets #29735c fill with #ffffff text.

3. Build a feature card: a 576px column, background #f8f5f4, border-radius 8px, padding 48px, no border, no shadow. Title in MT Neue Text 32px weight 400, line-height 1.25, color #151515. At a 12px gap, a description in MT Sans 16px weight 360, line-height 1.5, color #151515cc. At a 16px gap, a text link in MT Sans 14px weight 600, color #151515, ending in "→". At a 48px gap, a mockup tile: background #ffffff, radius 6px, padding 16px, box-shadow `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)`, with column labels in MT Mono 11px weight 500 uppercase at 0.66px tracking.

4. Build a navigation bar: background #ffffff, height 64px, static position, inner container 1200px. On the left, a 17px-tall wordmark in #29735c. In the center, menu items in MT Sans 14px weight 500, color #151515, padding 4px 8px, radius 4px, hover background #f8f7f5. On the right with an 8px gap: "Log in" and "Start building" as outline buttons (transparent, #151515 text, `inset 0 0 0 1px #151515`, radius 2px, padding 6px 12px, 14px weight 600) and "Talk to us" as a solid #151515 button with #ffffff text at the same size. Below the nav, a #f8f7f5 announcement strip with 14px 32px padding and centered 14px weight 500 text.

5. Build a stat row: three equal columns inside 1200px with a 48px gap, each with a 1px #15151533 top and bottom border and 32px vertical padding, text centered. Set the number in MT Neue Display 47px weight 450, line-height 1.25, color #151515. Set the label in MT Sans 16px weight 360, line-height 1.5, color #15151580. No fills, no radius, no icons.

## Green Belongs to Money

The chromatic discipline is that forest green marks money in motion and nothing else. It appears as #29735c on the active rail, the current step and the selected entity type, as #bae0cf on tags and JSON highlights, and as #0c221d on the footer. Three things would break it: a green CTA, green link text, or a second saturated hue for a status. Each would make color mean "brand" instead of "money is here", and the hero's single lit ACH tag would lose its force. To extend the system, give any new data object (a balance, a settlement, a webhook event) a mint tag and allow exactly one #29735c instance per view for its active state. New actions stay #151515, so green stays the one hue on the page.

## Ink-Ring Elevation

Depth is drawn, not cast. Every button carries `inset 0 0 0 1px #151515`, cards recess into #f8f5f4, and stats and the logo strip are bounded by #15151533 rules, the way columns are ruled in a ledger. Two moves would break this: adding the md or lg shadows to site chrome, or swapping the inset ring for a 1px CSS border. The first turns the page into a dashboard. The second grows outline buttons 2px wider than solid ones and misaligns every pair. To extend it, give new containers a tonal step (Paper to Parchment) or a hairline. Reserve shadow for white tiles that depict the product, so floating always means "this is the software" rather than "this is the website".

## Optical-Size Typography

Hierarchy runs on optical cuts and size, not weight. MT Neue Display at 450 owns 47px and 71px, MT Neue Text at 400 owns 21px and 32px, MT Sans sits below at 330 and 360, and the heaviest stroke, 600, belongs to button labels. Bumping headlines to 600, using the Display cut at 32px, or tracking headlines would each break it: headlines would outrank actions or lose their book-like texture. To extend the system, keep the 1.5 step: a new step below 21px belongs to MT Sans, never a smaller Neue. Any new emphasis comes from moving up the size ladder or switching to MT Mono 11px uppercase labels.

## Similar Brands

- **Vercel** — The same ink-black #151515-style primary buttons, 1px ring outlines and Geist Mono uppercase labels on a near-white canvas. Vercel runs cooler and grayer, where Modern Treasury warms the paper and adds one green.
- **Ramp** — Black CTAs on a warm off-white canvas with a single rationed accent hue. Ramp's accent is a bright yellow-lime used more loudly, while Modern Treasury confines green to data objects.
- **Mercury** — Fintech product mockups rendered as calm, low-shadow UI fragments on tinted panels. Mercury leans on soft gradients and larger radii, which Modern Treasury refuses.
- **Increase** — A bank-infrastructure API sold through monospace endpoints, JSON exhibits and near-zero decoration. Increase is starker and more terminal-like, where Modern Treasury softens it with Parchment cards and display serifs-free book-weight headlines.
- **Stripe** — The direct payments-API competitor with live code panels and rail-by-rail product framing. Stripe spends color on gradient backdrops, while Modern Treasury holds a one-hue budget and flat ruled surfaces.
